Compare order-volume costs, custom rules and connector coverage.
Your order volume changes the software bill
Base combines subscription and order-volume pricing, with a separate Enterprise offer. Compare your actual account costs with the implementation, hosting and maintenance of an owned application.
The exceptions become the daily process
B2B approvals, custom fulfilment rules and unusual ERP handoffs need more than another manual step. Implement the rules around your own order and customer data in Open Mercato.
You cannot afford to lose a working connector
Base has a large ready-made integration catalog. List every marketplace, store, carrier and ERP flow before a migration. Open Mercato integrations are explicitly assessed and built for the project.

See an example of custom shipping automation.
The MDM NT case study describes a custom shipping implementation connected to business systems. It illustrates the delivery approach; it is not a claim that every Base connector is available out of the box.
Read the MDM NT story ↗
Open Mercato core order workspace. Explore MDM NT’s custom shipping workflow in the case study.
Migrate the order flow without breaking fulfilment.
Inventory the working connections
List marketplaces, stores, carriers, ERP systems, warehouses, currencies and every automatic action. Identify which connections can stay during a phased rollout.
Map the operational data
Preserve SKU and offer identifiers, order statuses, addresses, payments and shipment references. Assign the system of record for stock and prices.
Pilot one channel end to end
Test order intake, updates, stock behavior, cancellations, payment reconciliation, labels and tracking. Include retries, duplicate prevention and failure alerts.
Reconcile and switch carefully
Set a data freeze and final synchronization plan, reconcile open orders, train operators and retain a tested rollback path.
Questions before you take the next step.
Is Open Mercato a drop-in BaseLinker replacement?
No. Base provides a large catalog of ready-made ecommerce integrations. Open Mercato is a custom application foundation. The required marketplace, carrier and ERP connections must be assessed and implemented before switching.
Does Open Mercato charge per order?
The MIT-licensed core has no per-order licence fee. Hosting, implementation, maintenance, support and external-provider usage still contribute to total cost.
Can we keep Base for marketplace connectivity?
A hybrid architecture can be scoped with Base handling selected channels and Open Mercato owning customer or operational processes. Define record ownership, synchronization and error handling before implementing it.
When is this a good fit?
When a distinctive operational workflow, code ownership or long-term application control justifies a custom implementation. A standard connector-led shop may be better served by a ready-made ecommerce platform.
Bring the order exceptions your current setup cannot handle cleanly.
Start with your channels, monthly order range, ERP and fulfilment rules. Scope a practical pilot before committing to a full migration.
